question: What recovery guarantee should experimental `claws update` provide when a package installer or Gateway cron mutation may have succeeded but cannot be proven or fully compensated?
rationale: The code can fail closed and preserve uncertain state, but only maintainers can decide whether operator inspection/replanning is an acceptable experimental contract or whether a durable doctor/reconcile workflow is required before exposing mutation.

options.title: Require recoverable operations before merge
options.body: Add a documented doctor/retry/reconcile path with durable operation identity and exact-head live proof for uncertain external mutations.

options.title: Accept bounded experimental recovery
options.body: Keep fail-closed `update_partial` plus operator inspection/replanning, but require exact-head live proof and explicitly document that limited recovery guarantee.

options.title: Pause the mutation stage
options.body: Defer update apply until the broader Claw lifecycle stack and recovery contract receive maintainer sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Require recoverable operations before merge
recommendation.body: Add a documented doctor/retry/reconcile path with durable operation identity and exact-head live proof for uncertain external mutations.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment identifies the unresolved recovery and live-proof decision directly.
